scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.desktop: concurrently -k -n server,web,app -c blue,magenta,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev" "npm --prefix desktop run dev"
scripts.desktop:start: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix demo install
